name: GlitchHPF
description: Pre-sc3.4 single-precision second order Butterworth high pass filter. Drop-in replacement for HPF that restores the older single-precision behaviour (HPF was changed to double precision in sc3.4 / svn r10300, 8 Sep 2010), producing the deliberately aliased/broken sound of the original implementation. From sc3-plugins GlitchUGens.

name: GlitchRHPF
description: Pre-sc3.4 single-precision resonant high pass filter. Drop-in replacement for RHPF that restores the older single-precision behaviour (RHPF was changed to double precision in sc3.4 / svn r10300, 8 Sep 2010), producing the deliberately aliased/broken sound of the original implementation. From sc3-plugins GlitchUGens.

inputs.name: rq
inputs.description: Reciprocal of Q. Bandwidth / cutoff frequency. Lower values = more resonance
